title_ar: من نواذيبو.. الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو يطلق برنامجه العلمي والدعوي لهذا العام  بمحاضرات في القيم الإيمانية وإصلاح المجتمع
title_en: From Nouadhibou — Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Launches This Year's Scholarly and Da'wah Programme with Lectures on the Values of Faith and the Reform of Society
body_ar: أطلق فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو ـ زوال اليوم الثلاثاء 21 يوليو 2026مـ من مدينة نواذيبو، برنامجه العلمي والدعوي لهذا العام، مستهلًا جولة علمية وإرشادية تتضمن محاضرات عامة ودروسا علمية ولقاءات دعوية، في إطار رسالته الساعية لترسيخ القيم الإسلامية، وتعزيز الوعي الديني، والدعوة إلى التمسك بالكتاب والسنة، والحث على فضائل الأخلاق.وقد شهد اليوم الأول من البرنامج حضورا واسعا ضم عددا من العلماء وطلبة العلم والأئمة والدعاة، إلى جانب جمع غفير من سكان المدينة الذين توافدوا لحضور أولى محاضرات الشيخ والاستفادة من دروسه العلمية.وقد تناول فضيلة الشيخ في مفتتح برنامجه العلمي ـ لهذا العام ـ من مركز الجودة للعلوم الشرعية، مكانة العلم وفضل تعلمه وتعليمه والحث على رعاية مؤسساته واحتضان طلابه ودعم القائمين عليها فهو مسؤولية الجميع مؤكدا أن بالعلم يحصل الوفاق وتتحقق الأخوة وينتشر العدل ويعبد الله بما شرعكما تناول في المحاضرة الثانية التي احتضنها جامع قباء عوامل صلاح المجتمع ومحاربة فساد الأخلاق وكل ما من شأنه أن يسهم في قيم المجتمع موضحا أن من مظاهر الفساد إشاعة الباطل مذكرا الحضور بواجب المسلم تجاه أمته ووطنه محذرا الشباب خاصة من المخدرات والمعاصي، مشيرا أن صلاح المجتمع يبدأ من الفرد ثم الأسرة ثم الجيران، معددا مجموعة من عوامل الإصلاح كالدعوة إلى الله وتعليم الناس الخير والتواصي بالحق وتعزيز روح الأخوة الإسلامية والتكافل ونصرة المظلوم ومنع الظالم من ظلمه مستشهدا بقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم " انصر أخاك ظالما ومظلوما فقال رجل: يا رسول الله، أنصره إذا كان مظلوما، أفرأيت إذا كان ظالمًا كيف أنصره؟ قال: تحجزه أو تمنعه من الظلم فإن ذلك نصره " كما دعا إلى العمل على تغيير المنكر بالوسائل المشروعة. مؤكدا الأمم تبنى بالقيم وأن صوت الناخب أمانة في عنقه، فلا يجوز بيعه أو استغلاله في غير الحق، لأن بيع الأصوات مشاركة في الفساد وإفساد للشأن العام، داعيا إلى استحضار مراقبة الله تعالى عند أداء هذه الأمانة.كما تحدث عن قضية الرزق والكسب، مبينًا أن استعجال بعض الشباب لجمع المال قد يدفعهم إلى سلوك طرق محرمة مؤكدا أن الرزق مكتوب وأن المؤمن مطالب بتحري الحلال والابتعاد عن الربا وسائر المكاسب المحرمة لما لها من آثار مدمرة على الأفراد والمجتمعات، وأن الإقبال على الله تعالى وتقواه من أعظم أسباب البركة وسعة الرزق.وأكد أن تحمل المسؤولية يعد من أهم عوامل صلاح المجتمعات، فكل فرد شريك في بناء وطنه وخدمة مجتمعه ولا ينبغي أن ينتظرغيره ليقوم بالإصلاح بل عليه أن يسهم في المصالح العامة ويحذَر من أن يكون سببا في نشر الفساد أوالمعاصي أو وسيلة لتعريف بما يريده خصوم الإسلام الساعين لخراب المجتمعات، مؤكدا أن من تمام الإيمان أن يكون المسلم مفتاحا للخير، وداعية إلى الفضيلة والإصلاح.ويتواصل البرنامج خلال الأيام المقبلة بمحاضرات ودروس ولقاءات علمية ودعوية مع علماء المدينة وأئمتها وجهائها، في إطار تعزيز التواصل والتعاون في خدمة الدعوة، ونشر العلم الشرعي، والإجابة عن أسئلة رواد المساجد وعمارها، وترسيخ قيم الوسطية والاعتدال، وحث الشباب على التمسك بالكتاب والسنة، والإسهام في بناء المجتمع على أسس العلم والإيمان والأخلاق.ويهدف برنامج الشيخ لهذا العام إلى الجمع بين التربية الإيمانية والتأصيل العلمي، من خلال طرح قضايا تمس واقع المسلمين، وتربطهم بأصول دينهم، وتعينهم على فهم الأحكام الشرعية وتطبيقها في حياتهم اليومية بأسلوب يجمع بين وضوح الطرح والاستدلال بالكتاب والسنة والاستفادة من أقوال العلماء واجتهاداتهم.ويتناول البرنامج سلسلة من الموضوعات التي ترسيخ القيم الدينية، وفي مقدمتها عوامل اصلاح المجتمعات، ونصرة المسلمين، ومحبة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، واتباع سنته، إلى جانب بيان مكانة العلم وفضل تعلمه والحث على نشره وتقريبه واحتضان طلبته ورعاية مؤسساته، والتمسك بمنهج السلف الصالح، وترسيخ معاني الأخوة الإسلامية والوحدة ونبذ أسباب الفرقة والنزاع.
body_en: At midday today — Tuesday 21 July 2026 — His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew launched this year's scholarly and da'wah programme from the city of Nouadhibou, beginning a scholarly and guidance tour taking in public lectures, scholarly classes and da'wah meetings, within the framework of his mission of establishing Islamic values, strengthening religious awareness, calling for holding fast to the Book and the sunnah, and urging the virtues of character. The first day of the programme saw a wide attendance that included a number of scholars, students of knowledge, imams and callers to Islam, alongside a great throng of the city's people who came to attend the Sheikh's first lectures and to benefit from his scholarly classes. At the opening of his scholarly programme for this year, at the al-Jawdah Centre for the Sharia Sciences, His Eminence the Sheikh took up the standing of knowledge and the merit of learning and teaching it, and the urging of care for its institutions, the embracing of its students and support for those who run them — for it is everyone's responsibility — affirming that through knowledge concord is reached, brotherhood is realised, justice spreads, and God is worshipped as He has prescribed. In the second lecture, hosted by the Quba congregational mosque, he took up the factors of the soundness of society and the combating of the corruption of character and of everything liable to bear on society's values, explaining that among the manifestations of corruption is the spreading of falsehood, reminding those present of the Muslim's duty towards his community and his homeland, warning the young in particular against narcotics and acts of disobedience, and pointing out that the soundness of society begins with the individual, then the family, then the neighbours. He enumerated a set of factors of reform, such as calling people to God, teaching people what is good, enjoining the truth upon one another, strengthening the spirit of Islamic brotherhood and of mutual support, coming to the aid of the wronged, and preventing the wrongdoer from his wrongdoing — citing the saying of the Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace: "Aid your brother, whether he is a wrongdoer or wronged. A man said: Messenger of God, I aid him when he is wronged — but tell me, when he is a wrongdoer, how do I aid him? He said: You restrain him, or you prevent him from wrongdoing; for that is aiding him." He also called for working to change what is wrong by lawful means; affirming that nations are built upon values, and that the voter's vote is a trust upon his neck, so that it is not permissible to sell it or to exploit it for anything other than the truth, because the selling of votes is a participation in corruption and a corrupting of public affairs — calling for the awareness of God Almighty's watching to be brought to mind when this trust is discharged. He also spoke on the question of provision and earning, explaining that the haste of some young people to amass money may drive them to take forbidden paths, affirming that provision is already written, and that the believer is required to seek out what is lawful and to keep away from usurious gain (ribā) and from all other forbidden earnings, for what they bring of ruinous effects upon individuals and societies; and that turning towards God Almighty and being conscious of Him are among the greatest causes of blessing and of ample provision. He affirmed that bearing responsibility is reckoned among the most important factors of the soundness of societies, for every individual is a partner in building his homeland and serving his society, and he ought not to wait for someone else to carry out the reform; rather he must contribute to the public good and take care not to be a cause of the spreading of corruption or of acts of disobedience, or a means of making known what the adversaries of Islam want, who seek the ruin of societies — affirming that it is part of complete faith that the Muslim be a key to what is good and one who calls to virtue and to reform. The programme continues in the coming days with lectures, classes and scholarly and da'wah meetings with the city's scholars, its imams and its notables, within the framework of strengthening contact and cooperation in the service of da'wah, spreading Sharia knowledge, answering the questions of those who frequent and maintain the mosques, establishing the values of balance and moderation, urging the young to hold fast to the Book and the sunnah, and contributing to the building of society on the foundations of knowledge, faith and character. The Sheikh's programme for this year aims to bring together the cultivation of faith and grounding in scholarship, by raising questions that touch the reality of the Muslims, that bind them to the foundations of their religion, and that help them to understand the Sharia rulings and to apply them in their daily lives, in a manner that combines clarity of presentation with argument from the Book and the sunnah and with drawing on the statements of the scholars and their independent reasoning (ijtihād). The programme takes up a series of subjects that establish religious values, foremost among them the factors of the reform of societies, coming to the aid of the Muslims, love for the Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, and following his sunnah — alongside setting out the standing of knowledge and the merit of learning it, urging its dissemination and its being brought within reach, the embracing of its students and care for its institutions, holding fast to the way of the righteous predecessors, and establishing the meanings of Islamic brotherhood and unity and the casting off of the causes of division and dispute.

flags.context: the hadith cited in the second lecture
options: Aid your brother, whether he is a wrongdoer or wronged
Help your brother, whether he is the oppressor or the oppressed
Come to your brother's aid, wronging or wronged
flags.note: The report gives the hadith with its dialogue but supplies no narrator, no collection and no grading; it is in al-Bukhari, but style guide section 4 forbids adding an attribution the Sheikh did not give, so none has been added. The rendering must keep the point of the hadith, which turns on the second half redefining what aiding a wrongdoer means; 'help' in option 2 weakens that.

flags.arabic: ويعبد الله بما شرعكما تناول في المحاضرة الثانية
flags.context: the junction between the first and second lectures
options: treat as two sentences: '...as He has prescribed.' / 'In the second lecture...'
treat شرعكما as a single word and translate accordingly
mark the text as corrupt at this point
flags.note: The source runs بما شرع and كما تناول together as شرعكما, with no space and no full stop. This is a typesetting defect, not a word: شرعكما is not readable here. body_ar preserves it as served; body_en reads it as بما شرع. كما تناول, which is the only sense the passage admits. Style guide section 11 requires the defect be recorded, not silently fixed.

flags.arabic: وأن صوت الناخب أمانة في عنقه، فلا يجوز بيعه
options: the voter's vote is a trust upon his neck, so that it is not permissible to sell it
the elector's vote is a trust he carries, and selling it is not allowed
a vote is an amānah, and vote-selling is forbidden
flags.note: lā yajūz is the negation of jāʾiz and means 'it is not permissible'. It is not the same as ḥarām, and option 2's 'forbidden' would raise the ruling a grade — precisely the error style guide section 3 warns against. The idiom 'a trust upon his neck' is kept because the Arabic image is doing work: a trust one carries and will answer for.

flags.context: the opening of the final sentence
options: read as التي ترسخ, 'that establish religious values'
read as التي تُرسِّخ, 'that consolidate religious values'
flags.note: The source has a relative pronoun followed directly by a verbal noun with no verb, which is ungrammatical. The intended verb is evidently ترسخ or ترسّخ. body_ar preserves the defect; the English reads the minimal repair and flags it here.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk summarising a series of lectures. Everything ascribed to the Sheikh is the desk's summary.

The body is one unbroken block in the source, with sentences run together without spaces after several full stops; body_ar preserves this and body_en is paragraphed only as far as the sense requires, which is not at all — it is rendered as the single block the Arabic is.
The tatweel character is used as a dash twice in the dateline and twice around 'for this year'; preserved in body_ar, rendered as em dashes.
ينتظرغيره and أوالمعاصي are run together without spaces in the source and are preserved as served.

The date in the body (Tuesday 21 July 2026) is four days before the CMS stamp of 25 July; the ISO date follows the CMS stamp as elsewhere in the corpus. Records 1394 and 1396 are stamped seventeen minutes apart on the same evening, which is a batch upload; date_is_cms_upload is therefore true.

منهج السلف الصالح is rendered 'the way of the righteous predecessors', which is what the Arabic says; it has not been rendered 'the Salafi method', which would attach the text to a movement the source does not name.
